purpose: AC-POLL-1: poll_open binds the stored Poll.creatorPubkey to the dispatcher-resolved authenticated sender, never the self-asserted payload.creatorPubkey (inherited-verified: was already correct from S2? No — this was a real gap, fixed here). AC-POLL-2 (inherited from S2, verified/kept): poll_vote already keys PollVote.voterPubkey and PollVote.id on sender.pubkey. AC-POLL-3 (inherited from S2, verified/kept): poll_close authorization already compares sender.pubkey against the stored creatorPubkey, not rumor.pubkey. AC-POLL-4 (green-field, the substantive new work): on an accepted poll_close, the persisted Poll.results/Poll.totalVoters are recomputed from the PollVote rows this client has actually stored (pollPersistence.loadVotes), never taken from the close message's results/totalVoters fields — closing a real app-layer forgery (a poll creator faking final counts). The recompute is a pure function of the stored vote set (AC-XCUT-2: order-independent, and independent of which subset of votes this client has observed — eventual-consistency on completeness is accepted, forgeability of the reported numbers is not).

public_api.description: Unchanged signature. Internal handleOpen now stores creatorPubkey: sender.pubkey instead of payload.creatorPubkey (AC-POLL-1).

public_api.name: createPollVoteHandler

public_api.name: createPollCloseHandler

Internal handleClose now recomputes results/totalVoters from deps' poll-store accessor (AC-POLL-4) instead of writing payload.results/payload.totalVoters verbatim.

public_api.description: Gains one new field: loadVotes: (pollId: string) => Promise<PollVote[]>, injected exactly like getPoll/savePoll/saveVote (coordinator override of this story's original direct-import decision — see RETROSPECTIVE remediation entry). Wired through the shared registerHandlers.ts HandlerDeps/pollDeps composition root and MarmotContext.tsx's pollPersistence import + PollHandlerDeps construction, mirroring getPoll's wiring exactly.
